title: Ya zehra
body:
Ya zehra
Ya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
(Fetema zehra) x2
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
1. (Ay meri bibi) x2
tere dar pe istighasa he, tera mamnoon meri shehzadi ye jaha sara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
2. tu hame hifz or amaan dede, apni chadar ke saiban dede, teri kudrat me kya nahi bibi, tu jise chahe do jahaan dede
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
3. (ay meri bibi) x2
aansu-o mein duwa mangi hai, teri tasbee hi parke dil ne tuje pukaara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
4. tera darbaar wo sakhi dar hai, har farishta jahaan gadaagar hai, tere makrooz asmaan waale tera makrooz har sikandar hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
5. (ay meri bibi) x2
tu sakhi hai tere bache bhi, ek raahi nahi gawaahi me jag ye saara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
6. farshe majlis pe aur musalle par, har jawaa keh raha hai roro kar, ham rahe na rahe magar bibi, ta qayamat rahe game sarwar
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
7. (ay meri bibi) x2
tere bacho ka gham manaa te hai, apni awlaad se kahi barke gham ye pyara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
8. karz makrooz ka adaa karde, mufliso ka naseeb wa karde, jinki godi bhari nahi bibi unko awlaad tu ataa karde
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
9. (ay meri bibi) x2
bas tuhi muraad deti hai, teri chawkhat dare ilahi ka isti araa hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
10. farz momin se gham juda karde, bas ghame karbela ataa karde, be khataa kayd me hai jo momin, mojize se unhe rihaa karde
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
11. (ay meri bibi) x2
gham koyi hussainiyo ko na de, jo hussaini hai tere baba ko jaan se pyaara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
12. un shaheedo ka ye mukadar hai, sayibaan inka teri chadar hai, unke sino pe ay meri bibi daaghe maatam nishaane haider hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
13. (ay meri bibi) x2
khuld me shaheed jab jaye, teri awaaz aaye aane do ye hamaara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
14. majlise gham me ashk barsaane, aasake ya nahi khuda jaane, kya bharosa hamaari saanso ka, ab kahaa ham kahaa azaa khaane
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
15. (ay meri bibi) x2
ashke gham teri amaanat hai, teri awlaad ke hi gham ne hame sawaara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
16. tujko ummat ne yu sataaya hai, marghe mohsin pe bhi rulaaya hai, tujko baba ke baad ummat ne, haaye darbaar me bulaaya hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
17. (ay meri bibi) x2
kitne sadme utha hai tune, ji te ji tujko meri shehzadi gham ne maara hai
<<MINI>>
(ya zehra) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
18. (ay meri bibi) x2
tere darpe sar jukaa te hai, har hussaini ka tere tukro pe hi guzaara hai
Warke matam sha (Fatema zehra) x2
Aalame walaa (Fatema zehra) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere man maula (Fatema zehra) x2
Sarware zehra (Fatema zehra) x2
Aaha wawayla
